When to go to Thailand

Thailand is not one season. The Andaman (Phuket, Krabi, Khao Lak, Phi Phi) is the winter sea. The Gulf (Samui, Phangan, Tao) is the summer sea. They overlap in winter. They do not overlap in autumn.

AndamanNovember to April
GulfJanuary to September
NorthCooler November to February

Bangkok is hot most of the year and wettest in September and October. You still go. You walk in the morning and sit in air-con at 14:00.

Chiang Mai has a cool season (November to February), a hot season (March to May, smoke risk), and a rainy season that is still usable.

Songkran in mid-April is a water festival, not a sightseeing week in the Old City. Book it on purpose or avoid the Old City lanes that week.

Common questions

Is there a single best month?
December to February if you want both Bangkok and the Andaman. July if you want Samui and can take Bangkok heat.
Can you visit Phuket in August?
You can. Some days are beautiful. Boat days cancel. Prefer Samui in that month unless a resort is the whole point.
